description: Records whose top-level steps still speak US institutions and await restructuring: restructuring one means moving the US mechanics into step-level geoResolutions US entries so the step text becomes the global abstraction (the first-wave pattern pinned in lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts), and a record whose title scopes it to a national regime reclassifies as class (b) instead (the form_002/opp_002/tax_003 precedent; wave 3 added form_011, whose title names the US LLC form, whose CA geoNote is not-applicable, and whose n3 decision already carries the per-country entity options). When a record is restructured, remove it here; lib/__tests__/processGeoResolutions.test.ts fails if a listed record already carries resolutions, or if a listed id leaves the corpus. Empty after wave 3 (waves: PR #382, PR #398, and this one).
